batch_Q2.fix: M1 (partial) - Cursed Body and Poison Touch were paid inside _stepEffects, the SECONDARY step, where the authority pays them in the single runEvent(DamagingHit) below the secondaries and sorted order-ASC then target-index-ASC. Both deferred to a new _stepDamagingHitLate.

batch_Q2.risk_named_before_the_run: This is a GAME change, not a narration-only one. Poison Touch now runs BELOW the secondaries, so a secondary that lands a status first will refuse it where it used to land - and Cursed Body now reads m.fainted and m._vol.disable one step later. Either can move a board. The two 30% dice also change their relative nth at a shared address on a hit where both fire, so a value can swap there. Board-material is the clause that decides.
